type.family: Riforma (Swiss grotesque) — single family, all roles
type.pairing: none — differentiation is by size, case and tracking, not by family

layout.hero: full-bleed film still, edge-to-edge, type laid directly over it

designMap.signature: A frame of cinema is the hero. White uppercase type sits directly on a full-bleed film still; the only brand intrusions are the wordmark, the tracked headline, and one deep-blue button.

tasteDNA.name: Cinema is the hero
tasteDNA.trigger: The landing page needs a hero.
tasteDNA.decision: Use an actual full-bleed film still with type laid over it, not an illustration, gradient or product shot.
tasteDNA.reason: MUBI sells cinema, so the most persuasive asset is a frame of cinema itself; the design recedes so the medium does the talking.
tasteDNA.evidence: Hero is a dusk film still edge-to-edge; the headline sits in white directly on the image with no card or scrim box.

tasteDNA.name: One voice, no pairing
tasteDNA.decision: One grotesque (Riforma) for every role — display, nav, body, button — separated only by size, case and tracking.
tasteDNA.reason: A single typographic voice reads as authored editorial confidence; a second family would dilute it.
tasteDNA.evidence: Extractor found a single family; h1 50px/weight 500 and body 18px/weight 700 are the same Riforma.

tasteDNA.name: Refuse ornament (Restraint)
tasteDNA.decision: Keep corners square (2px) and surfaces flat (no elevation); spend nothing on chrome.
tasteDNA.reason: Sharp, flat surfaces keep all attention on imagery and type; rounding and shadows would compete with the film stills.
tasteDNA.evidence: Top radius value is 2px; box-shadow is effectively absent across the page.

tasteDNA.name: Exactly one colour
tasteDNA.decision: Reserve a single saturated colour (#001489) for the one primary action only.
tasteDNA.reason: One unmissable coloured object against monochrome and imagery makes the call-to-action impossible to miss.
tasteDNA.evidence: Accent candidates are led by rgb(0,20,137); the sign-up button is the only saturated element in the viewport.
